name: Pill Smoke (Đan Yên)
rule: A puff of censer smoke: a small Chaos hit. If a pill is prepared in your pill slot, the censer burns it once a fight to lay a cloud of 4 debuff stacks per pill grade for 6 s of the pill's element (Water smokes as Ice, no element as Wood).
notes: Self half-strength pill effect awaits full pill-effect combat support (engine.py Pill Smoke slice 3); burn_pill directly lays the foe stack cloud without a separate smoke-cloud Effect.
